SEARCH
Package controllers

Class SearchControllerTest

java.lang.Object
play.test.WithApplication
controllers.SearchControllerTest
public class SearchControllerTest extends play.test.WithApplication
Exercises search routing, rendering and asynchronous errors without live HTTP.

AI assistance: test-design support for the Phase 6 search interface, Phase 7 pagination, Phase 8 readability, and Phase 9 word statistics.

Author:
Nabeel Ali
